# Pressing hard cheese

Pressing pushes the last whey out of the curds and knits them into a firm wheel of cheese, as for cheddar or gouda. The pressed wheel then goes to [[Aging cheese in a cave]].

Line a mould with cheesecloth, pack in the drained curds from [[Rennet and curds]], and press with light weight for an hour, then heavier weight overnight.

Unwrap, flip and redress the cheese between pressings so the rind forms evenly on both faces.
